headline: Jon Small, Director and Early Billy Joel Collaborator, Dies at 79
context: They were in two bands together before Mr. Joel became famous, and briefly fell out over Mr. Joel’s affair with Mr. Small’s wife. Mr. Small later found success as a director of music videos and concert films.
